title: THE BAR SHOWS ITS DRINKS
why: Seen on the 4K bar screenshot of 2026-10-08: The Last Pour listed Liquor and Blotter as bare lines of text, the only station with no pictures. Each drink now leads with its picture, the same icon the raid shows down the left while it is in your blood, so the two connect at a glance.
now: The bar shows a picture for each drink, matching its status icon in a raid.
